'''Erek Krieger''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Private/Legends|private]] in the [[Republic Army]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Erek had an older sister named [[Alli Krieger|Alli]], and he joined the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] out of a desire to protect his family. However, Erek was one of the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] who were assigned to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Oricon]] during the [[Dread War]], and his exposure to the moon's energies damaged his mind like many others. He was evacuated and discharged back to his family, who took care of him and helped him recover from the trauma.<ref name="SWTOR" /><ref name="Mail">{{TORcite|type=message|My brother the private.|Alli Krieger}}</ref>
